note: Twenty queries a real person might type, with what a good plan for each must contain. Written by hand on 2026-09-27 before any of them were run, so the expectations are not reverse engineered from what the system happens to produce. Budgets vary on purpose: a 30 minute plan and a 120 minute plan are different packing problems, and the short ones are where the budget constraint actually bites.
mustCoverNote: mustCover is checked by embedding each phrase and requiring some segment in the plan to match it above a floor. Phrases are written as a learner would describe the idea, not as an index label, so the check is not circular.
avoidNote: avoid lists things that are adjacent to the topic but are not it. A plan that spends real time here has drifted.
